name: Lightarr
description: Lightarr is a home automation tool that connects your Plex server to your Wiz light bulbs. Add this lightweight and simple to use app to your *arr collection and enjoy! For a video guide check out my video on YouTube: https://youtu.be/4YhPkRt-W6o

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Lightarr configs and data (such as rules, bulbs, etc)

variables.name: Plex Authentication Token
variables.description: Your plex auth token. Get it from https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/

variables.name: WIZ Subnet
variables.description: Network subnet to scan for Wiz bulbs. Change if your network uses a different range (e.g., 192.168.0.0/24, 10.0.0.0/24)
